title: docs(spec): the routes / App.apis retire text stops sending app authors to an imperative http.server route (ruling C′ item 2)
body:
Fixes #23216

Clause-②: no

Ruling C′ on #23128 (`6142279866`), item 2: the imperative `http.server` route is retired as an app-author surface. This PR changes the retire text and the published copies so they no longer send app authors to a `kernel:ready` handler. An app declares `defineStack({ apis })` (`type: 'object_operation'` or `'flow'`, ADR-0121), computes in a flow, and registers code as a stack function (`defineStack({ functions })`) or a connector. The `http.server` service, `core-service-contracts.ts` and the platform plugins that mount on it are untouched. No key is added or removed.

## What changed

| Site | Change |
|:---|:---|
| `packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.zod.ts` (`contributes.routes` retire message + TSDoc) | The imperative sentence is replaced by the app-author rule, with the reason: a code-mounted route gets no caller identity, auth gate, rate limit, namespace carve-out or OpenAPI entry. |
| `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts` (`App.apis` retire message) | **Surface extension, declared here.** The dispatch hypothesis said this row was a different key and should be edited only if it said the same thing. It does: it said "A route that genuinely needs handler CODE is mounted imperatively instead: resolve the `http.server` service … register the route on `kernel:ready`". This is the source of the `metadata.mdx` / `app.mdx` hits that the acceptance grep covers, and the claim names `metadata.mdx` "where it renders the same text". Code now goes to a flow plus a stack function or connector. |
| `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.plugin-manifest-contributes-routes-retired.ts` | The published `replacement` no longer gives the imperative advice or names the deleted showcase `POST /api/v1/showcase/recalc` route. `acceptanceCriteria` now describes the current teaching sites. `reason` is kept as is, because it records the earlier ruling. |
| `packages/spec/src/api/plugin-rest-api.zod.ts:34-39` TSDoc | The example now says it shows a **platform** plugin mounting its own doors, and states the app-author rule. The deleted recalc-endpoint "real consumer" claim is removed. |
| `packages/spec/liveness/manifest.json` row note | Same correction: the recalc-endpoint mention is removed and `http.server` is described as the platform plugins' primitive. |
| `scripts/check-optional-error-sink-contract.mjs:164` scope comment | `examples/**` now holds zero further red sinks, not one, because the recalc route was deleted. Comment only. |
| `packages/spec/src/kernel/manifest.test.ts` | The pin's regex used to match `…http\.server` (the old advice). It now asserts the new rule's substance (`does not mount routes on http.server` … `defineStack({ apis })` … flow … `defineStack({ functions })` … connector) and that `kernel:ready` / the imperative wording does not come back. The pin is changed, not deleted. |
| `content/docs/references/**` (5 pages) | **Generated, not hand-edited:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix` (it proved only `check:docs` stale) rewrote `kernel/manifest.mdx`, `api/package-api.mdx`, `api/metadata.mdx`, `ui/app.mdx`, `api/plugin-rest-api.mdx`. |
| `.changeset/23216-routes-retire-text.md` | `@objectstack/spec` `patch`. |

Each of the four pointer sites from `6147168221` was re-read on `main` at `4fe8b3def`. All four were still stale, and all four are edited here; none had been fixed already.

## Acceptance

- `git grep -n "mounted imperatively" -- packages/spec content/docs` finds nothing (exit 1).
- The manifest reference page renders the new sentence (`content/docs/references/kernel/manifest.mdx:92`): "… Delete the key. An app does not mount routes on `http.server` — that service is the platform's own door-building primitive, … Declare the endpoint under `defineStack({ apis })` (`type: 'object_operation'` or `'flow'`, ADR-0121), compute in a flow, and register code as a stack function (`defineStack({ functions })`) or a connector."
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date", exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: 680 files, 20784 passed, 1 todo, exit 0. This includes `retired-key-migrate-sentence.test.ts` and its family, and `manifest.test.ts`.
- Derived gates (`dispatch-gates --commands`, 131 families), run at head `3c31cd91`: 128 exit 0. 3 are NOT MEASURED locally because a prerequisite was not met (exit 3), and are declared to CI: `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` needs an unshallowed `main`; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure` need a full monorepo build. `--ran` reconciliation: "131 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 128 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED", exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- The published skill `skills/objectstack-api/SKILL.md:119` still has a decision-table row: "`http.server` mount (plugin code) — The endpoint needs real handler CODE … Mount it on `http.server`." It is the same retired advice, and its eval `skills/objectstack-api/evals/endpoints-auth-routes.json` may pin it. Both are outside this card's claimed surface, and `skills/**` is a Tier H governed surface, so they are not edited here. They are reported to the seat to file.
